narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The steepest climb is where the count doubled.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Say a count climbs from one thousand to one thousand two hundred. That is steep, yet it is not double.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A climb from one hundred to two hundred is smaller, yet it is double.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>Steepness cannot tell us. We must compare with twice the start.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Find twice the first reading, then compare the next reading with it.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. A line is about one hundred and fifty in one year. It is about three hundred and thirty the next year. Did it at least double?
